name: focus-simulator
description: A focus timer with a rest arcade, fading quotes, and a progress calendar.

scripts.test: node tools/build.mjs && node tools/merge-test.mjs && node tools/scrabble-rules-test.mjs && node server/mailbox-test.mjs && node server/accounts-test.mjs && node tools/account-client-test.mjs && node tools/smoke-test.mjs
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.ship: npm run build && node tools/merge-test.mjs && node tools/scrabble-rules-test.mjs && node server/mailbox-test.mjs && node server/accounts-test.mjs && node tools/account-client-test.mjs && node tools/smoke-test.mjs && electron-builder
scripts.publish:win: npm run publish:check && npm run build:release && electron-builder --win --publish always && node tools/publish-extra.mjs
scripts.publish:mac: npm run publish:check && npm run build:release && electron-builder --mac --publish always && node tools/publish-extra.mjs
scripts.publish:linux: npm run publish:check && npm run build:release && electron-builder --linux --publish always && node tools/publish-extra.mjs
